# Sam Vale — fictional career source
Relay Ops Services | Service Reliability Analyst | February 2020–August 2024
I was employed by Relay Ops Services and assigned to its client Harbour Care; Harbour Care was not my employer.
In 2022, during the Lantern failover rehearsal, I found a stale recovery credential and worked with the service owner to replace it before the scheduled failover. The scheduled failover completed. No avoided outage duration, financial savings or risk-reduction percentage was measured.
In 2023 I created the Moth handover checklist with shift colleagues. Both shifts used it and the incoming shift could locate unresolved tickets. This was a practical prevention and continuity contribution, not a measured productivity improvement.
Awarded ITIL Foundation certification in 2019 by Example Qualifications (fictional).
